subject: Problem on plotting TS using GGPLOT

messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Problem on plotting TS using GGPLOT
parts:
Hi,

I already have posted same problem in R-forum, however could not get
satisfactory reply. This can be seen here :
http://www.nabble.com/Problem-on-plotting-TS-using-GGPLOT-td25611332.html

My problem is following :
I have following codes :

library(zoo); library(ggplot2); library(plyr)
dat <- rnorm(306); vv <- letters[1:6]; dat1 <- data.frame(dat, vv)
dat2 = zooreg(rnorm(51), as.yearmon(as.Date("2000-01-01")),
frequency=12)

ggplot(dat1) +

geom_line(aes(y=dat, x=index(dat2), colour=vv), group=vv,
size =
1.3)





However I got error while plotting them :

Error in data.frame(x = c(2000, 2000.08333333333, 2000.16666666667,
2000.25,
:

arguments imply differing number of rows: 51, 306



I could not find why that error is coming. Any idea please ?



Thanks,

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Problem on plotting TS using GGPLOT
parts:
Hi,

I think your problem has more to do with getting a data.frame out of
zoo, for which I know nothing. From what I gathered on r-help though,
you can try this and see if it gets you started,

z <- zoo(matrix(dat, 51), time(dat2))
DF <- cbind(tt = time(z), as.data.frame(z))

DFm <- melt(DF, id=c("tt"))
head(DFm)
str(DFm) # this is a data.frame in long format that ggplot2 can use

ggplot(DFm) +
geom_line(aes(y=value, x=as.numeric(tt), colour=variable,
group=variable), size = 1.3)

HTH,

baptiste
